001package pkg_engine;
002
003import pkg_entities.Pokemon;
004import pkg_entities.Trainer;
005import java.util.ArrayList;
006import java.util.Random;
007import java.util.HashMap;
008import javax.swing.JButton;
009import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
010
011/** Manages battle state and turn processing. */
012public class BattleManager {
013    /** Game engine used to access player and world state. */
014    private GameEngine aEngine;
015
016    /** User interface used to display battle updates. */
017    private UserInterface aGui;
018
019    /** Current trainer opponent. */
020    private Trainer aOpponent;
021
022    /** Active player Pokemon in battle. */
023    private Pokemon aPlayerPokemon;
024
025    /** Active opponent Pokemon in battle. */
026    private Pokemon aOpponentPokemon;
027
028    /** Current HP of the active player Pokemon. */
029    private int aPlayerCurrentHP;
030
031    /** Current HP of the active opponent Pokemon. */
032    private int aOpponentCurrentHP;
033
034    /** Indicates whether a battle is currently active. */
035    private boolean aBattleActive;
036
037    /** Number of player Pokemon left that can battle. */
038    private int aPlayerPokemonLeft;
039
040    /** Number of opponent Pokemon left that can battle. */
041    private int aOpponentPokemonLeft;
042
043    /** Team slot index of the active player Pokemon. */
044    private int aPlayerPokemonIndex;
045
046    /** Team slot index of the active opponent Pokemon. */
047    private int aOpponentPokemonIndex;
048
049    /**
050     * Creates a battle manager attached to the engine and UI.
051     *
052     * @param pEngine the game engine that owns player and world state
053     * @param pGui the user interface used for battle output
054     */
055    public BattleManager(final GameEngine pEngine, final UserInterface pGui) {
056        this.aEngine = pEngine;
057        this.aGui = pGui;
058        this.aBattleActive = false;
059    } // BattleManager()
060
061    /**
062     * Starts a battle with the given trainer.
063     *
064     * @param pOpponent the trainer the player will battle
065     */
066    public void startBattle(final Trainer pOpponent) {
067        this.aOpponent = pOpponent;
068
069        // In test mode, auto-win the battle
070        if (this.aEngine.isTest()) {
071            this.aGui.println("\n[TEST] Auto-won battle against " + pOpponent.getName() + "!");
072            pOpponent.setDefeated(true);
073            if (pOpponent.getName().equals("Rayquaza")) {
074                this.aEngine.getPlayer().setHasWon(true);
075                this.aGui.println("Congratulations! You defeated Rayquaza and saved Hoenn!");
076            }
077            return;
078        }
079
080        this.aPlayerPokemonIndex = 1;
081        this.aOpponentPokemonIndex = 1;
082        this.aPlayerPokemon = this.aEngine.getPlayer().getPokemon(this.aPlayerPokemonIndex);
083        this.aOpponentPokemon = pOpponent.getPokemon(this.aOpponentPokemonIndex);
084
085        if (this.aPlayerPokemon == null || this.aOpponentPokemon == null) {
086            this.aGui.println("Error: Missing Pokemon!");
087            return;
088        }
089
090        this.aPlayerCurrentHP = this.aPlayerPokemon.getHp();
091        this.aOpponentCurrentHP = this.aOpponentPokemon.getHp();
092        this.aPlayerPokemonLeft = this.aEngine.getPlayer().getTeamSize();
093        this.aOpponentPokemonLeft = pOpponent.getTeamSize();
094        this.aBattleActive = true;
095
096        // Show trainer images first, buttons disabled
097        this.aGui.startBattle();
098        this.aGui.showPlayerPokemonImage("trainer_battle.png");
099        this.aGui.showOpponentPokemonImage(pOpponent.getName() + "_battle.png");
100        this.updateHP();
101        this.setupAttackButtons();
102        this.setButtonsEnabled(false);
103        this.aGui.println("\n" + pOpponent.getName() + " wants to battle!");
104
105        // Wait 2s, then switch to pokemon solo images and enable buttons
106        new Thread(() -> {
107            try {
108                Thread.sleep(2000);
109            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
110            }
111            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
112                this.aGui.showPlayerPokemonImage(this.aPlayerPokemon.getName() + " solo.png");
113                this.aGui.showOpponentPokemonImage(this.aOpponentPokemon.getName() + " solo.png");
114                this.setButtonsEnabled(true);
115            });
116        }).start();
117    } // startBattle()
118
119    /**
120     * Refreshes both HP bars from current and maximum values.
121     */
122    private void updateHP() {
123        this.aGui.setPlayerHP(this.aPlayerCurrentHP, this.aPlayerPokemon.getHp());
124        this.aGui.setOpponentHP(this.aOpponentCurrentHP, this.aOpponentPokemon.getHp());
125    } // updateHP()
126
127    /**
128     * Removes all action listeners from a button before re-binding battle actions.
129     *
130     * @param pButton the button to clear
131     */
132    private void clearListeners(JButton pButton) {
133        for (java.awt.event.ActionListener al : pButton.getActionListeners()) {
134            pButton.removeActionListener(al);
135        }
136    } // clearListeners()
137
138    /**
139     * Binds move and run actions to battle buttons for the active player Pokemon.
140     */
141    private void setupAttackButtons() {
142        this.clearListeners(this.aGui.getAttack1Button());
143        this.clearListeners(this.aGui.getAttack2Button());
144        this.clearListeners(this.aGui.getAttack3Button());
145        this.clearListeners(this.aGui.getAttack4Button());
146        this.clearListeners(this.aGui.getRunButton());
147
148        this.aGui.getAttack1Button().setEnabled(true);
149        this.aGui.getAttack2Button().setEnabled(true);
150        this.aGui.getAttack3Button().setEnabled(true);
151        this.aGui.getAttack4Button().setEnabled(true);
152        this.aGui.getRunButton().setEnabled(true);
153
154        HashMap<String, pkg_entities.Attack> vMoves = this.aPlayerPokemon.getMoves();
155        ArrayList<String> vMoveNames = new ArrayList<>(vMoves.keySet());
156
157        if (vMoveNames.size() > 0) {
158            this.aGui.getAttack1Button().setText(vMoveNames.get(0));
159            this.aGui.getAttack1Button().addActionListener(e -> this.playerTurn(vMoveNames.get(0)));
160        }
161        if (vMoveNames.size() > 1) {
162            this.aGui.getAttack2Button().setText(vMoveNames.get(1));
163            this.aGui.getAttack2Button().addActionListener(e -> this.playerTurn(vMoveNames.get(1)));
164        } else {
165            this.aGui.getAttack2Button().setEnabled(false);
166        }
167        if (vMoveNames.size() > 2) {
168            this.aGui.getAttack3Button().setText(vMoveNames.get(2));
169            this.aGui.getAttack3Button().addActionListener(e -> this.playerTurn(vMoveNames.get(2)));
170        } else {
171            this.aGui.getAttack3Button().setEnabled(false);
172        }
173        if (vMoveNames.size() > 3) {
174            this.aGui.getAttack4Button().setText(vMoveNames.get(3));
175            this.aGui.getAttack4Button().addActionListener(e -> this.playerTurn(vMoveNames.get(3)));
176        } else {
177            this.aGui.getAttack4Button().setEnabled(false);
178        }
179
180        this.aGui.getRunButton().addActionListener(e -> this.runAway());
181    } // setupAttackButtons()
182
183    /**
184     * Resolves one full player turn, including the opponent response and KO checks.
185     *
186     * @param pMoveName selected player move name
187     */
188    private void playerTurn(String pMoveName) {
189        if (!this.aBattleActive) {
190            return;
191        }
192
193        this.setButtonsEnabled(false);
194
195        HashMap<String, pkg_entities.Attack> vPlayerMoves = this.aPlayerPokemon.getMoves();
196        pkg_entities.Attack vAttack = vPlayerMoves.get(pMoveName);
197
198        if (vAttack == null) {
199            this.setButtonsEnabled(true);
200            return;
201        }
202
203        int vDamage = vAttack.getDamage();
204
205        // Player attacks - show damage gifs
206        if (vDamage == 0) {
207            this.aGui.println("\n" + this.aPlayerPokemon.getName() + " used " + pMoveName + "! But it missed!");
208        } else {
209            this.aGui.println("\n" + this.aPlayerPokemon.getName() + " used " + pMoveName + "! Dealt " + vDamage + " damage!");
210        }
211        this.aGui.showOpponentPokemonImage(this.aOpponentPokemon.getName() + " dammage.gif");
212        this.aOpponentCurrentHP -= vDamage;
213        if (this.aOpponentCurrentHP < 0) this.aOpponentCurrentHP = 0;
214        this.updateHP();
215
216        // Wait 2s for animation, then process result
217        new Thread(() -> {
218            try {
219                Thread.sleep(2000);
220            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
221            }
222            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
223                // Check if opponent fainted
224                if (this.aOpponentCurrentHP <= 0) {
225                    this.aGui.println(this.aOpponentPokemon.getName() + " fainted!");
226                    this.aOpponentPokemonLeft--;
227
228                    if (this.aOpponentPokemonLeft <= 0) {
229                        this.endBattle(true);
230                    } else {
231                        this.aOpponentPokemonIndex++;
232                        this.aOpponentPokemon = this.aOpponent.getPokemon(this.aOpponentPokemonIndex);
233                        this.aOpponentCurrentHP = this.aOpponentPokemon.getHp();
234                        this.aGui.println(this.aOpponent.getName() + " sent out " + this.aOpponentPokemon.getName() + "!");
235                        this.aGui.showOpponentPokemonImage(this.aOpponentPokemon.getName() + " solo.png");
236                        this.aGui.showPlayerPokemonImage(this.aPlayerPokemon.getName() + " solo.png");
237                        this.updateHP();
238                        this.delayThenEnable();
239                    }
240                    return;
241                }
242
243                // Opponent attacks back - pick random move
244                HashMap<String, pkg_entities.Attack> vOpponentMoves =
245                        this.aOpponentPokemon.getMoves();
246                if (vOpponentMoves.size() > 0) {
247                    ArrayList<String> vOpponentMoveNames = new ArrayList<>(vOpponentMoves.keySet());
248                    Random vRandom = new Random();
249                    String vOpponentMoveName = vOpponentMoveNames.get(vRandom.nextInt(vOpponentMoveNames.size()));
250                    int vOpponentDamage = vOpponentMoves.get(vOpponentMoveName).getDamage();
251
252                    if (vOpponentDamage == 0) {
253                        this.aGui.println(this.aOpponentPokemon.getName() + " used " + vOpponentMoveName + "! But it missed!");
254                    } else {
255                        this.aGui.println(this.aOpponentPokemon.getName() + " used " + vOpponentMoveName + "! Dealt " + vOpponentDamage + " damage!");
256                    }
257                    this.aGui.showPlayerPokemonImage(this.aPlayerPokemon.getName() + " dammage.gif");
258                    this.aPlayerCurrentHP -= vOpponentDamage;
259                    if (this.aPlayerCurrentHP < 0) {
260                        this.aPlayerCurrentHP = 0;
261                    }
262                    this.updateHP();
263
264                    // Wait 2s for player damage animation
265                    new Thread(() -> {
266                        try {
267                            Thread.sleep(2000);
268                        } catch (InterruptedException e2) {
269                        }
270                        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
271                            if (this.aPlayerCurrentHP <= 0) {
272                                this.aGui.println(this.aPlayerPokemon.getName() + " fainted!");
273                                this.aPlayerPokemonLeft--;
274
275                                if (this.aPlayerPokemonLeft <= 0) {
276                                    this.endBattle(false);
277                                } else {
278                                    this.aPlayerPokemonIndex++;
279                                    this.aPlayerPokemon = this.aEngine.getPlayer().getPokemon(this.aPlayerPokemonIndex);
280                                    this.aPlayerCurrentHP = this.aPlayerPokemon.getHp();
281                                    this.aGui.println("Go, " + this.aPlayerPokemon.getName() + "!");
282                                    this.aGui.showPlayerPokemonImage(this.aPlayerPokemon.getName() + " solo.png");
283                                    this.aGui.showOpponentPokemonImage(this.aOpponentPokemon.getName() + " solo.png");
284                                    this.updateHP();
285                                    this.setupAttackButtons();
286                                    this.delayThenEnable();
287                                }
288                            } else {
289                                // Both alive - back to solo images, enable buttons
290                                this.aGui.showPlayerPokemonImage(this.aPlayerPokemon.getName() + " solo.png");
291                                this.aGui.showOpponentPokemonImage(this.aOpponentPokemon.getName() + " solo.png");
292                                this.setButtonsEnabled(true);
293                            }
294                        });
295                    }).start();
296                } else {
297                    // Opponent has no moves
298                    this.aGui.showOpponentPokemonImage(this.aOpponentPokemon.getName() + " solo.png");
299                    this.setButtonsEnabled(true);
300                }
301            });
302        }).start();
303    } // playerTurn()
304
305    /**
306     * Waits briefly, then re-enables battle buttons if battle is still active.
307     */
308    private void delayThenEnable() {
309        new Thread(() -> {
310            try {
311                Thread.sleep(2000);
312            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
313            }
314            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
315                if (this.aBattleActive) {
316                    this.setButtonsEnabled(true);
317                }
318            });
319        }).start();
320    } // delayThenEnable()
321
322    /**
323     * Enables or disables battle action buttons based on move count and state.
324     *
325     * @param pEnabled {@code true} to enable allowed actions
326     */
327    private void setButtonsEnabled(boolean pEnabled) {
328        int vMoveCount = this.aPlayerPokemon.getMoves().size();
329        this.aGui.getAttack1Button().setEnabled(pEnabled);
330        this.aGui.getAttack2Button().setEnabled(pEnabled && vMoveCount > 1);
331        this.aGui.getAttack3Button().setEnabled(pEnabled && vMoveCount > 2);
332        this.aGui.getAttack4Button().setEnabled(pEnabled && vMoveCount > 3);
333        this.aGui.getRunButton().setEnabled(pEnabled);
334    } // setButtonsEnabled()
335
336    /**
337     * Finalizes a battle, shows outcome text, and returns to exploration mode.
338     *
339     * @param pPlayerWon {@code true} if the player won
340     */
341    private void endBattle(boolean pPlayerWon) {
342        this.aBattleActive = false;
343        this.setButtonsEnabled(false);
344
345        if (pPlayerWon) {
346            this.aGui.println("\nYou won the battle!");
347            this.aOpponent.setDefeated(true);
348            if (this.aOpponent.getName().equals("Rayquaza")) {
349                this.aEngine.getPlayer().setHasWon(true);
350                this.aGui.println("Congratulations! You defeated Rayquaza and saved Hoenn!");
351            }
352        } else {
353            this.aGui.println("\nYou lost the battle!");
354        }
355
356        // Show trainer images again
357        this.aGui.showPlayerPokemonImage("trainer_battle.png");
358        this.aGui.showOpponentPokemonImage(this.aOpponent.getName() + "_battle.png");
359
360        // Wait then return to exploration
361        new Thread(() -> {
362            try {
363                Thread.sleep(2000);
364            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
365            }
366            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
367                this.aGui.endBattle();
368                this.aGui.println(this.aEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getLongDescription());
369            });
370        }).start();
371    } // endBattle()
372
373    /**
374     * Ends the current battle as a run-away action and returns to exploration.
375     */
376    private void runAway() {
377        this.aGui.println("\nYou ran away!");
378        this.aBattleActive = false;
379        this.setButtonsEnabled(false);
380
381        // Show trainer images again
382        this.aGui.showPlayerPokemonImage("trainer_battle.png");
383        this.aGui.showOpponentPokemonImage(this.aOpponent.getName() + "_battle.png");
384
385        new Thread(() -> {
386            try {
387                Thread.sleep(1000);
388            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
389            }
390            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
391                this.aGui.endBattle();
392                this.aGui.println(this.aEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getLongDescription());
393            });
394        }).start();
395    } // runAway()
396}
